question: Which deities are to be worshipped on the right and left sides of the door?
premises: Mahālakṣmī is placed on the right.
Sarasvatī is placed on the left.
Both are included in the door worship.
inference: Mahālakṣmī should be worshipped on the right and Sarasvatī on the left of the door.
plain_english: On its right Mahālakṣmī, and on the left Sarasvatī.
